posts.text:
Secretary Rubio is absolutely right and I commend him for taking on the corrupt global bureaucrats who want to prosecute American soldiers. 

The ICC is corrupt to its core and a direct threat to our sovereignty. 

The Trump Administration is right to push back.
posts.summary: Praises Rubio for opposing ICC prosecution of U.S. soldiers
